# A query in a tab whose fetch answers at once, and whose @load writes what
# the tab renders, on every target.
#
# The render builds the query's instance, the instance's mount answers, and
# the @load asked for the same render while it was running. Re-entered, the
# render built the instance afresh -- the list it reuses from is set only at
# its end -- whose mount answered again, until gtk4's stack overflowed. A
# render asked for while it runs now runs after it (renderOnce).

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import async "sngl:async"
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

// A word as a lookup answers it, at once: itself, marked.
func lookUp(word string) async.Result[string] {
    return {ok="{word}!"}
}

func kinds() list[string] {
    return ["Red", "Green", "Yellow"]
}

component page ui.node {
    var tab = 0
    var kind = "Red"
    var seen map[string, string] = {}

    // The words the kind chosen shows, each as the lookup answered it.
    func words() list[string] {
        return ["{kind}-a", "{kind}-b"].map(func(w string) => seen.get(w, w))
    }

    ui.tabs #tabs(:selected=tab) {
        ui.tab(label="First") {
            ui.text(value="first")
        }
        ui.tab(label="Second") {
            ui.vbox {
                for var w = ["{kind}-a", "{kind}-b"] {
                    async.query(on=w, fetch=lookUp, @load(got) { seen[string.replace(got, "!", "")] = got })
                }
                ui.select #pick(:value=kind) {
                    for var k = kinds() {
                        ui.choice(label=k, value=k)
                    }
                }
                for var w = words() {
                    ui.text #word(value=w)
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

ui.window {
    page()
}

func testEachChoiceTakes(t test.Test, c page) {
    c.tabs.change(1)
    t.assert(c.pick != null)
    if c.pick != null {
        c.pick.change("Green")
    }
    t.assert(c.kind == "Green")
    t.assert(c.words().format(",") == "Green-a!,Green-b!")
    if c.pick != null {
        c.pick.change("Yellow")
    }
    t.assert(c.kind == "Yellow")
    t.assert(c.words().format(",") == "Yellow-a!,Yellow-b!")
}
